description: Use L1-L5 bid/ask ladder slope, convexity and depth concentration over the lookback window.
Use signed changes in L1-L5 quantities and replenishment/withdrawal counts before entry.
Use L1 and L2-L5 microprice displacement from mid, computed before entry.
Use rolling spread percentile, spread compression/expansion and tight/loose regime flags.
Use rolling trade-volume acceleration and volume imbalance proxies before entry.
Use open/midday/close bucket only, not future session outcomes.
